# Count Dojo

> Count Dojo is an iPhone and Android app that teaches blackjack card counting from zero to casino-ready, as a graded course. Counting is a legal skill; the app is training only — no real-money play, no promise of winnings.

Facts below match the live app (v1.18.0) and its App Store listing as of 2026-11-15.

## What it teaches
- Six units, 89 lessons (71 core + 18 side branches): Blackjack Foundations, Learning to Count, True Count & Bet Sizing, Playing Deviations, Casino Readiness, Advanced Advantage Play.
- Counting system: Hi-Lo is used in every lesson, drill, and simulator session. One side-branch lesson compares seven alternatives (KO, Red Seven, Hi-Opt I, Hi-Opt II, Omega II, Zen Count, Wong Halves).
- 21 drill types across basic strategy, counting, true count and betting, deviations (Illustrious 18, Fab 4, extended), and an integrated drill. Medal tiers: bronze, silver, gold, legend.
- Casino simulator: deals from a real shuffled shoe of 1–8 decks with a cut card at the chosen penetration; H17/S17, DAS, RSA, late surrender, 3:2 or 6:5; heat, distractions, and graded cover play. Six presets: Vegas Main Floor, Vegas Strip High-Limit, Downtown Vegas, Atlantic City, Tough Vegas, Strip Low-Limit (6:5).
- Reference: 48 strategy charts, deviation indices, bet spread tables, Edge Calculator, Bankroll Planner, an 842-casino database, a Results Tracker, and a 126-term glossary.

## Plans (US App Store prices, November 2026)
- Free: all of Unit I unlimited; Units II–VI open but paced by hearts (5 max, one refills every 3 hours); seven practice drills; basic strategy chart, glossary, Results Tracker.
- Premium: unlimited hearts, all drills, full simulator, every tool. $4.99/week, $9.99/month, $59.99/year, or $119.99 lifetime.
- Pro Tools (for players who already count): Edge Calculator, Bankroll Planner, full casino database, full simulator — no curriculum upgrade. $4.99/month, $24.99/year, or $49.99 lifetime.
- Billing and refunds go through Apple or Google.
